reasons.A: Chatty, confiding first person with short punchy sentences breaking longer loose ones, ironic quoted stock words and a leisurely period register closest to the passage's whimsical amble.
reasons.B: Right period feel and genteel irony, but its balanced, polished essay sentences and neat tricolon endings are more composed than the passage's digressive, aside-laden movement.
reasons.C: Plain modern register, explanatory and even-toned, with little of the passage's whimsy, quotation play or period diction.
